summary: Iteration 6 verified both changes plus a full regression. BACKEND: rewrote the obsolete TestBusinessImages class into TestImageFeatureRemoved (POST/DELETE /api/business/image/{logo|photo} -> 404, GET /api/public/{slug}/image/{kind} -> 404, no logo/photo/image keys in GET /api/settings or GET /api/public/{slug} (public business payload is exactly name/category/location), no logo_url/photo_url/'business/image'/PIL references left in server.py) and hardened the host-spoofing test to 7 payloads. Whole suite: 66/66 pytest PASSED (serial run, /app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml). SECURITY FIX CONFIRMED: 'https://evil.com#@google.com/', 'https://evil.com\@g.page/r/x/review', 'https://evil.com\\@g.page/r/x/review', 'https://google.com@evil.com/review', 'https://evil.com?@g.page/r/x/review', 'https://evil.com/g.page/r/x/review', '//evil.com#@google.com/', 'https://evil.com/?x=google.com', 'https://google.com.evil.com/x', 'https://notgoogle.com/x', 'https://example.com/review' all return 422 with the friendly message and the stored link is unchanged; all 9 valid Google shapes (g.page/r, g.page/{name}/review, maps.app.goo.gl, g.co/kgs, search.google.com/local/writereview, www.google.co.in/maps, share.google, schemeless -> https, http -> https) save 200 and persist; empty clears the link and sets is_active=false. FRONTEND (preview URL, Playwright): My Business shows only the business form + 'Your QR code & link' card - no 'Your logo'/'shop photo' text, 0 file inputs, QR renders (naturalWidth 450); all 6 spoof links show exactly one 'That does not look like a Google link...' toast and the previously saved link survives a reload; schemeless link saves and is normalised. Public /r/PCiXONhzO_7mFA renders 'Sharma Dental' + 'Dental Clinic · Pune', 0 elements, 6 tappable cards; tapping card 1 marks the review USED and the browser navigates to exactly https://g.page/r/CVxyz123/review even without clipboard access (clipboard fallback fix verified by intercepting the external navigation). Regression all green: login, ADD NEW with count 10 (total 5 -> 15, available 10, ~35s), reviews table, pagination (10/25/50, page info, prev/next, selection cleared on page change), bulk select-all/copy/delete (15 -> 13), single edit (persisted after reload) / regenerate / copy / delete, categories add + delete, change password wrong-current error toast, logout, mobile 390x844 with scrollWidth == clientWidth == 390 on /reviews, /settings, /categories and the public page. Demo account left with name 'Sharma Dental' / 'Dental Clinic' / 'Pune' / 'Kothrud, Pune', link https://g.page/r/CVxyz123/review (ACTIVE), 12 reviews (6 available / 6 used).

minor.issue: Replaces every business field with the request body, so a client that posts a partial body silently wipes name/business_category/location (reproduced from the UI - see frontend integration issue). Consider PATCH-style partial update or requiring the full body explicitly.

Links with an explicit port ('https://google.com:8080/x') are rejected because urlsplit().hostname is compared but netloc keeps the port only for the stored value - cosmetic/inconsistent (carry-over, harmless).

Carry-over: `visible = [...] or rows` still falls back to already-used reviews, so once every review is used a repeat customer is served (and re-marks) a used review; the counters then do not move. Currently reproducible on the demo account whenever available == 0.
pillow and boto3 are now unused after the image feature removal (server.py no longer imports them) - safe to drop to shrink the image.

integration_issues.flow: Reviews -> Copy all / Copy row, My Business -> Copy link
integration_issues.issue: navigator.clipboard.writeText() is called without try/catch in Reviews.js copy()/copySelected() and Settings.js 'Copy link'. When the clipboard permission is denied the promise rejects unhandled -> 'Uncaught runtime errors: NotAllowedError: Failed to execute writeText on Clipboard' (dev overlay covered the whole page and blocked further clicks) and the user gets no toast at all; Settings.js even shows 'Link copied' regardless. PublicReview.js already has the correct pattern - apply the same guard (fallback toast with the text) to these three call sites.

The form renders enabled and empty before GET /api/settings resolves and there is no loading/disabled state, so a Save issued in that window PUTs empty name/business_category/location and permanently wipes the saved business details (reproduced: the demo account's name/category/location were blanked by a fast save right after page load; I restored them via the API). Fix: disable the form/Save until the fetch resolves, or make PUT /api/settings a partial update.

action_items: Wrap the three unguarded navigator.clipboard.writeText() calls (Reviews.js copy + copySelected, Settings.js Copy link) in try/catch with a fallback toast so a denied clipboard never produces an unhandled rejection or a false 'copied' toast
Add a loading/disabled state to the My Business form (and/or make PUT /api/settings partial) so a Save before the initial GET resolves cannot blank name/category/location
(carry-over) GET /api/public/{slug}: stop falling back to already-used reviews when nothing is available; show a friendly 'no reviews yet' state instead
(cleanup) drop pillow/boto3 from backend/requirements.txt now that the image feature is gone
critical_code_review_comments: normalise_google_url now parses with urlsplit().hostname and normalises backslashes - correct fix; note the fallback regex `(www\.|maps\.|search\.|business\.)?google\.[a-z]{2,3}(\.[a-z]{2})?` also accepts non-Google TLDs like google.xyz, and host.endswith('.goo.gl')/'.google.com' allows any subdomain - acceptable but worth a comment.
Server-side re-validation is still missing on POST /api/public/{slug}/use - a link stored before the fix would keep being served to customers; consider re-running normalise_google_url on read.
regenerate_review still builds GenerateIn(count=10) then calls generate_batch(cfg, 1) - dead override (carry-over).
clean_business() only strips logo_path/photo_path; since the feature is gone those keys should be $unset from existing business documents (a one-off migration) rather than filtered forever.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the two iteration changes and all listed regression flows; 2 robustness/integration issues found (clipboard, pre-load save)

seed_data_creation: Registered one throwaway account test_qa_it6_1787217481@qa-reviewboost.com / QaPassw0rd!23 (walkthrough test) plus the per-run fresh_client accounts from pytest. Owner account: reviews regenerated via ADD NEW (category QA_it6); now 12 reviews (6 available / 6 used); one row carries the text 'QA it6 edited...' then was regenerated. Business fields and Google link restored to the requested demo values.
test_credentials: owner@reviewboost.demo / ReviewBoost123! (unchanged; the change-password round-trip test restores it)
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope; TestReviews / TestBulkDelete / TestPublic all mutate the same owner reviews and DO flake under xdist (bulk-delete removes the 2 newest rows, which are TestReviews' freshly generated ones -> 404 on delete). Run the suite with `-n 0` for a clean result, or run those classes serially. TestReviews now self-cleans stale TEST_QA rows first. TestImageFeatureRemoved covers the removed logo/photo feature (all 404 + no image keys). Public-page tap testing: intercept navigation with page.route and abort non-preview hosts, then assert the captured URL == the stored Google link. On mobile (390px) the sidebar is off-canvas: click the header hamburger before [data-testid="logout-button"]. On /settings always wait until settings-name-input has a non-empty value before typing/saving, otherwise the save wipes the business fields (see frontend issue).
rca_of_the_issue: Security fix works because the host is now taken from urllib.parse.urlsplit(url).hostname after backslashes are normalised to '/', so fragment ('#@google.com'), query ('?@g.page'), userinfo ('google.com@evil.com') and backslash spoofs all resolve to the real host and fail the allow-list. Logo/photo removal is complete on both tiers (no endpoints, no DB keys in responses, no UI section, no CSS). The two new findings are client-side robustness gaps: unguarded clipboard writes (unhandled promise rejection + false success toast) and an editable/submittable My Business form during the initial fetch, which combined with the full-replace semantics of PUT /api/settings can silently blank the business details.
